hints.tr: Tarihleri `re.findall(r"\b\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}\b", text)` ile bul, her birini derste `read_numeric` gibi bir yardımcıyla oku.
hints.en: Find the dates with `re.findall(r"\b\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}\b", text)` and read each with a helper like `read_numeric` in the lesson.

hints.tr: Olmayan günü `try: datetime(year, month, day)` / `except ValueError:` ile yakala.
hints.en: Catch a day that does not exist with `try: datetime(year, month, day)` / `except ValueError:`.
